scope: Complete the inherited uncommitted inventory and Claude-skill fixes, independently reproduce regressions, and test the command recipes. No scientific evidence, cleanup targets, or recovered Git objects are changed.

new_findings.cause: Shared-index discovery separately listed Git directories outside the selected root, followed a symlinked Git directory, counted non-files, and suppressed listing failures.
new_findings.reproduction: Disposable separate-git-dir and symlinked-.git fixtures instrument Python directory enumeration; a directory named sharedindex.NOT_A_REGULAR_FILE was reported as a file.
new_findings.resolution: Derive root-relative regular-file paths from the existing bounded, no-follow traversal. Limit them to direct children of this worktree's Git directories. State that uninspected storage and stale shared-index files prevent inferring active split-index state.

new_findings.cause: A casefold-prefix comparison sliced an original path using the length of a differently spelled Git top-level; Unicode casefold expansion can change that length.
new_findings.reproduction: On case-insensitive APFS, requested Repoß/sub aliases disk ReposS/sub. With sub mode 0311 and a populated sibling repository ReposSsub, the inherited draft inventories that sibling, including outside_only.txt, with both completeness flags true and no errors.
new_findings.resolution: Verify ancestor filesystem identity with samefile, then reconstruct the suffix by path components. The same fixture now retains the selected directory and reports incomplete traversal without sibling entries.

new_findings.cause: Two colliding tracked names could both claim one folded disk entry when neither name matched its spelling exactly.
new_findings.reproduction: Index Data.txt and data.txt with only DATA.TXT on disk: the draft reported neither tracked path missing. A second real-Git fixture reproduces the same error using NFC, NFD, and a mixed Unicode spelling.
new_findings.resolution: Preserve exact matches but require a unique normalized tracked name for each non-exact match; ambiguous names remain in tracked_paths_not_inventoried.

new_findings.cause: The skill assumed .git was a directory and omitted the main worktree index when reviewing from a linked worktree.
new_findings.reproduction: From a linked audit worktree, the literal .git/worktrees/stale/index query fails with Not a directory. Resolved common-directory paths expose staged-evidence.txt in the stale record and main-staged-evidence.txt in the main index.
new_findings.resolution: Resolve Git metadata paths through guarded Git queries; inspect main and linked administrative indexes against their own HEADs and report failed or unborn-HEAD comparisons as unverified.

follow_up_coverage.change: Check the resolved tracked entry's type, retain collision protection, recognize differently spelled gitlinks, and accept Git's regular-file symlink representation only with core.symlinks=false.
Retain partial reports for unreadable roots, use a deadline exception the helper cannot swallow, preserve special-character scratch paths, and verify root/worktree containment.
Replace the configuration-dependent split_index boolean with observed shared_index_files and conditional mtime-refresh wording; do not claim stale files prove an active split index.

Execute alias-safe local Git recipes, separate consented remote inspection, gate status on effective attributes and ignore submodules, propagate pack-producer failures, and attribute reflog reachability through both nonzero entry sides with configuration-aware retention.

Keep proposal approval distinct from cleanup authorization; distinguish guard removal coverage and null classes; state exit status through the two completeness flags and the separate tracked-path gap list. PR prose and the eventual squash message must use the same contract.

inventory_suite.skip_reason: The filesystem rejects the non-UTF-8 filename fixture.

behaviors: local transport block and explicit remote-query exception
submodule filter avoidance with a positive control
unnamed reflog ancestors and stash parents
main and linked indexes compared against their own HEADs
unborn or missing HEAD and missing or invalid index reported as unverified

historical_regression_checks: Seven focused tests against an isolated 22312f3 helper produced six assertion failures, with no setup errors or skips.
Three focused tests against the inherited uncommitted helper produced four assertion failures across subtests, with no setup errors or skips.
Two new third-spelling collision tests failed semantic assertions against the pre-903 helper while the exact-spelling collision control passed; there were no setup errors or skips.
Removing O_NONBLOCK in an isolated helper caused the FIFO deadline to raise an uncaught BaseException, rather than recording a normal hash error.
focused_verification.lint: ruff check passed on the helper and both test modules

interpretation_limits: This is an engineering review, not a scientific experiment or a data-retention authorization.
Focused results here do not substitute for the required locked full gate or green Linux and macOS CI on the reviewed PR head; those receipts belong to the PR.
The remote-query recipe uses a disposable local origin in tests, not a live external service.
Recovered local history stays protected by recovery refs and disabled automatic maintenance; this change does not restore ledger rows, publish private history, or authorize Git housekeeping.
